# Sourdough notes

## What a starter is

A starter is flour and water colonised by wild yeast and lactic acid bacteria. It never
needs commercial yeast once it is established.

## Feeding schedule

Feed once a day at room temperature, or once a week if it lives in the fridge.

## Baking day

Mix in the morning, shape in the afternoon, bake the next morning after a cold proof.
